title: Judgment Record
description: One judgment made by a decision model, stored as an immutable record. Judgment Architecture v0.1 (draft).

record_id.description: Unique, immutable identifier for this record.

state_ref.description: Reference to the state that was judged. Store a hash, not the raw content, when the content is sensitive.

uri.description: Where the state can be retrieved, if retained.

fields.description: Field paths the question pointed at, e.g. ticket.messages[0].text

consequence_class.description: C0 observe · C1 reversible · C2 costly-reversible · C3 irreversible

pack.description: Question pack the question belongs to.

id.description: Pinned model version actually used, e.g. jev-1.13.0 — never an alias.

value.description: Chosen option (choice), level or weighted score (score), or P(yes) (noul).

probabilities.description: Full distribution over options or levels, as returned.

threshold.description: Threshold in force for this consequence class at decision time.

threshold_basis.description: How the threshold was set, e.g. 'chow r=3 e=12, recalibrated 2026-09-01'.

band.description: Hedge UI band the result was presented in.

action.description: What the system did, e.g. auto_reply_sent, escalated_to_human.

review.description: Filled when a human reviewed this judgment. Appended as a new record in strict event-sourced stores.

outcome.description: What eventually turned out to be true, when known.

supersedes.description: record_id of an earlier record this one corrects.
